parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a decriminalised environment with a 2024 hate-crime statute explicitly covering gender identity — a functioning legal protection that is visitor-facing, not merely resident-facing. No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented targeting of gender-nonconforming people, no police-lever use of any former statute, and the repeal of the old provision is recent and deliberate. The absence of documented incidents in a jurisdiction with a functioning legal system is a moderately positive signal. Open questions remain: facilities access, custody placement, entry screening, and a note that practice can vary from statute are unmeasured — these are unanswered questions, not exposures, so they hold the score below the 0.85 tier rather than dragging it down. No trans-specific violence data exists either way; extrapolating from structural signals (decriminalisation, enhanced hate-crime protection, no documented enforcement against trans people, no regime of state threat-framing), this sits in the reduced-risk band.
